arms.better: tm should stop the focused recovery from repeating nearly the same inspection sequence: it revisited crates/ignore/src/dir.rs and walk.rs across three no-change attempts and accumulated 584,797 tokens without a patch or test. The user-facing sequence is hard to follow: ‘Provider request failed. Waiting …’ is followed by ‘A retry is scheduled,’ but the run ends escalated with ‘No retry is scheduled’ and asks the user to run `tm ticket retry T-1`. Keep provider transport retries distinct from no-progress attempts, surface cumulative usage while retrying, and conclude with one next action that matches the final ticket state.

OpenCode found the parent-matcher cache in crates/ignore/src/dir.rs, removed reuse across roots, added a multiple-root regression in walk.rs, and accurately reported its targeted and package test results. It could make the plan and final summary even more useful by naming the root-specific cache invariant up front and including the exact test command and a concise changed-file summary. The independent package check passed after assigning this clone its own Cargo target directory; sharing the ambient target directory during concurrent checks initially produced misleading failures.
